name: NASA GISS ModelE3 1950–1951 simulation output
model_or_instrument: NASA GISS ModelE3 (One-Moment Aerosol / OMA scheme)
size_as_stated: 35,040 timesteps over the entire 2-year period (17,520 timesteps for 1950 training, entire 1951 for testing)
resolution: 2° latitude by 2.5° longitude (90 x 144 grid), 62 vertical levels, 30-minute intervals

scales.note: Global simulation of 1950-1951 (35,040 half-hour timesteps) at 2° latitude by 2.5° longitude.
